page.overview:
Who is Aaron Fischer?

Aaron Fischer grew up in Hastings, Missouri– a small town where he was consistently harassed and ostracized. When he was a teenager, his mother developed cancer and his father was abusive. Aaron's father blamed him for the death of his mother. He ran away from home with his boyfriend, Jeremy Klein, but Jeremy eventually returned to Hastings, leaving Aaron on his own.

Following the trails of homeless people gone missing, Aaron ended up at a Roxxon facility in the western US desert. There, he met Adrian who told him that Roxxon had been kidnapping homeless people and forcing them into labor camps. Aaron took this opportunity to don the Captain America mantle. He defeated Roxxon employees then escaped with Adrian. He traveled the rails with Adrian, with whom he had romantic relations, for an indeterminate amount of time.

While traveling through New York City, Aaron was on a train attacked by Speed Demon, who was impersonating Captain America. Having believed Aaron to be the culprit, Steve Rogers and Sam Wilson confronted him. Aaron explained himself, and gave a brief version of his backstory and how he spent his days defending people on the railways. He also went on to tell Sam and Steve about the Captains Network, a group of self-made Captains America all across the country. After noticing a sniper laser on his chest, Steve tackled Aaron to save him from Sin's shot.

Later, Aaron traveled with Arielle Agbayani to Colorado to reconvene with Sam and Steve, as well as Bucky Barnes. While Steve and Bucky attempted to recruit John Walker, Sam back at the safehouse with Aaron and Arielle, got the news that NORAD's Valhalla Base was under attack. The team headed to the facility and went up against Commander Krieger (Warrior Woman), Sin, Speed Demon, and Hate-Monger. At the end of the battle Krieger escaped with Hate Monger, leaving Speed Demon and Sin behind.
